name: token-monitor
description: Native Codex usage monitor with optional SSH remotes and explicit setup.

interface.shortDescription: Local and SSH Codex usage monitor
interface.longDescription: Set up, diagnose, update, and uninstall TokenMonitor, an independent native monitor for local and optional SSH remote Codex usage. Remote setup is managed in the app Settings and uses a dedicated SSH identity; it does not reuse OpenAI remote connections. Apple silicon and macOS 13 or later required. Includes a prebuilt companion app; no Python, Xcode, MCP server, or model calls are needed by the monitor. Setup installs six user hooks and a per-user launch helper. macOS first-open approval and Codex hook trust are required. Removing this plugin alone does not uninstall the companion.
